answer: Added the main menu as a plain inline keyboard in bot.py: three buttons on separate rows labelled Orders, Settings and Help, under the short prompt "What would you like to do?". No button is styled primary; this is a 3-button menu, so it stays an ordinary text message with an inline keyboard, not a rich message or a widget. /start and the Back buttons now show this menu. Existing callback_data values (order, profile) are kept; the new ones are orders, settings, help.
